nodes.biuro.text.t: The captain sits behind a table knocked together from the planks of a wrecked boat. On the wall hangs a map with the word "Whirl" scraped into it with a knife. "From the mainland, but useful. That's what they say about you. What can I do for you? And mind you remember: the Hetman's Camp is over the hill by the bay, in case the hetman ever asks after you."

nodes.meld_jarnowo_kuznia_dalej.text.t: "Still forging? Well, of course. The smith has hands, the handguns have orders, the war has an appetite. I'll write it down without comment."

nodes.meld_jarnowo_kuznia_sabotaz.text.t: "Flawed barrels? I'll remember not to stand near whichever marksman got your handguns. Noted."

nodes.meld_jarnowo_kuznia_stop.text.t: "The smith stopped forging handguns? The hetman will go through the roof, but smiths seldom listen to a hetman when they're holding a heavy hammer."

nodes.meld_jarnowo_proch_kapitan.text.t: "Powder handed over to the harbour arsenal? Honest enough. The hetman will have something to shoot with and you'll have a clear conscience, and one of the two is bound to come in handy."

nodes.meld_jarnowo_proch_ukryty.text.t: "Hid the barrels, did you? Where, I won't ask. What matters is that somebody knows where they are, and somebody else doesn't."

nodes.meld_jarnowo_proch_zatopiony.text.t: "You sank the whole cargo? The harbour elders will weep and the fish will sneeze. Noted."

nodes.meld_jarnowo_przejscie_odrzucone.t.t: "You went through the gate? Brave or stupid. In the Hetman's Camp that's pretty much the same thing."

nodes.meld_jarnowo_przejscie_uzyte.text.t: "You went by Nipper's passage? Good. The lad's the only man on this island who knows three ways out of every room."

nodes.meld_jarnowo_rozpoznanie_zapis.tex.t: "Brygida's drawings stay? Good. Things we don't understand get written down at least so somebody after us can make sense of them."

nodes.meld_jarnowo_rozpoznanie_zniszczon.t: "Burned the notes, did you? Sensible. Things nobody understands are safest when they don't exist."

nodes.meld_jarnowo_wiesc_przekazana.text.t: "Passed the news to the hetman? Good that somebody here still says what he knows. That'll come in useful."

nodes.meld_jarnowo_wiesc_zatrzymana.text.t: "Kept the news to yourself? Sensible or shabby, depending which way you look at it. Noted."

nodes.plotki.text.t: "They say something glows on Bald Rock at night, but nobody goes there, because the boats come back without helmsmen. They also say there's a wall in the House of Black Glass, behind the Shipyard, that answers back if you hold the right iron to it. In the Hetman's Camp, over the hill by the bay, hardly anyone shows up uninvited. And that up north lie the wrecks of a whole fleet, and nobody remembers who sent it."

nodes.powrot.text.t: Captain Wars looks up from his maps and sets down the knife he was cleaning his nails with. "Ah, the man from the mainland. Back again, so we must still have something to talk about. What can I do for you this time?"

nodes.zlecenia.text.t: "The board hangs on the quay. Take what suits you. When the job's done, you come to me, I write it in the ledger, somebody pays. That ledger's the only thing on this island nobody's burned yet."
